in_hebrew.name: Ferree
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Free, Exalted One
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ferree הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'eleutheria', meaning 'freedom'. In Christian tradition, this name is given to celebrate the spiritual freedom that comes from faith. The name may also be associated with exalted or noble status, as seen in the Greek goddess 'Eleutheria' who represented liberation and freedom.
